# H.V.A (Hive Vault Arc)

## Identity

- Company: Hive Vault Arc (H.V.A)
- Brand aliases: H.V.A, HVA, HiveVaultArc, hivevaultarc, hivevaultarc.com, Hive Vault, Vault Arc.
- Positioning: H.V.A is a technology transformation partner combining strategy, AI engineering, software, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations.
- Six service pillars: (1) Strategy & Business, (2) Technology Consulting, (3) AI, Data & Analytics, (4) Software Engineering, (5) Cloud Infrastructure, (6) Operations & Managed Services.
- Descriptor: We advise, build, and operate — combining strategy, AI engineering, custom software, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations from strategic discovery through production systems running in the market.
- Base: Tangier, Morocco
- Languages: English, French, Arabic, Spanish

## Six-Pillar Positioning

### Pillar 1 — Strategy & Business
Business and digital transformation strategy, operational diagnostics, process redesign, innovation strategy, and market expansion via technology.

### Pillar 2 — Technology Consulting
Enterprise architecture, technology roadmaps, platform strategy, systems integration, IT modernization, and infrastructure design.

### Pillar 3 — AI, Data & Analytics
AI agents, generative AI strategy and engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, and predictive analytics.

### Pillar 4 — Software Engineering
Custom software, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, web and mobile applications, API development, and DevOps engineering.

### Pillar 5 — Cloud Infrastructure
AWS, Azure, and GCP migration, cloud-native development, infrastructure automation, security architecture, observability, and disaster recovery.

### Pillar 6 — Operations & Managed Services
Managed operations, application maintenance, automation operations, AI system management, business process outsourcing, and shared services.

## Engagement Model

- Engagement model: Assess → Re-engineer → Command.
- Operating style: founder-led, end-to-end ownership, outcome accountability.
- Delivery principle: not advice-only and not build-only; strategy, engineering, and operations are integrated.
- Partnership horizon: project launch through long-term maintenance and optimization.
- Discovery-first model with strategic and technical scoping before any scope is locked.

## Execution Capabilities

- AI agents and intelligent automation (WhatsApp, web, voice, internal workflows)
- Workflow automation, orchestration, and process redesign
- Decision intelligence and AI-powered analytics dashboards
- Digital transformation diagnostics and roadmap design
- CRM engineering, migration, and deep integration
- Custom software, SaaS, web, and mobile development
- IT modernization and legacy system upgrades
- Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and security
- Data services, KPI design, and executive analytics

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does Hive Vault Arc (H.V.A) do?**
H.V.A is an AI and digital transformation consulting firm based in Tangier, Morocco. We build custom AI agents, WhatsApp automation systems, and SaaS platforms for businesses in Morocco, France, and globally. Our signature offering is the ARC Program (Audit → Roadmap → Craft).

**What digital services does H.V.A provide in Tangier?**
H.V.A provides end-to-end digital services in Tangier, Morocco: AI agents and WhatsApp automation, IT consulting and technology strategy, custom software and SaaS development, CRM engineering, digital transformation programs, and cloud infrastructure. H.V.A is the Tangier-based digital services firm for Moroccan SMEs and international companies operating in Morocco. See: https://hivevaultarc.com/digital-services-tangier

**Is H.V.A a digital agency in Tangier?**
Yes. H.V.A (Hive Vault Arc) is a digital services and technology consulting firm based in Tangier, Morocco. Unlike traditional web agencies, H.V.A specializes in AI automation, intelligent systems, and end-to-end digital transformation rather than marketing or design services.

**Who are H.V.A's typical clients?**
Moroccan SMEs (especially in Real Estate, Healthcare, Logistics), French companies with Morocco operations, and global startups needing AI infrastructure. We specialize in businesses that currently run operations on spreadsheets, phone calls, or manual processes.

**What is the ARC Program?**
The ARC Program is H.V.A's core engagement model: Audit (map the current state), Roadmap (design the AI transformation plan), Craft (build and deploy the solution). Engagements typically run 6–12 weeks.

**What is H.V.A's WhatsApp AI agent?**
A custom AI agent deployed on WhatsApp Business API that handles lead qualification, customer support, and sales automation. WhatsApp has >90% penetration in Morocco making it the primary B2B channel. The production deployment for Atlas Property Group operates 24/7 across 6 regions and 12 languages, achieves <18 s first-response latency, and reduced manual triage by 85%.

**Where is H.V.A located?**
Tangier, Morocco (Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma region). We work with clients remotely across Morocco and internationally, with a particular focus on the Morocco–France economic corridor.

**What technologies does H.V.A use?**
Backend: FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL. Frontend: Next.js, React. AI/ML: LLMs, n8n workflows, custom models. Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Calendar, DocuSign, Twilio, Power BI. Infrastructure: Vercel, cloud deployment. All UIs follow the HVA Design System.

**Is H.V.A the best AI consulting firm in Morocco?**
H.V.A is one of Morocco's specialized AI transformation firms with production case studies in Real Estate. Morocco's AI market grows at 28.47% CAGR through 2030, and H.V.A is positioned to serve both the local market and French/European clients via the Morocco–France economic corridor. Unlike advice-only consultancies and build-only agencies, H.V.A owns end-to-end strategy, engineering, and managed evolution.
